system.description:
Spellblades, gishes, arcane knights, and eldritch tricksters all. Magi are arcane specialists that blend magic and martial prowess.


Iconic Magi

• Alucard, Castlevania

• Elric of Melniboné, Stormbringer

• Geralt of Rivia, The Witcher

• Twilight Suzuka, Outlaw Star


Playing Magus

The magus may be a bit more challenging for newer players. Their playstyle is more build-dependent than the other classes, allowing for backline blasters, midline harassers, and frontline strikers.


Action: Attack/Cast

Move: Flexible

Starting Pack: Knight, Gladiator, or Warrior


Training: Arcana, Melee

features.name: Arcanum
features.description:
You gain the Gish Perk (p. 68) and you can Cast Spells using Arcana.


Spells: You learn 2 Spells, one of which must always have a damage base. You learn 1 other Spell every 3 Levels hereafter.


Mana: Your Max Mana is equal to (2 × your Level), and the highest amount of Mana you can spend to Cast a Spell is equal to (1 + half your Level, round up).

features.name: Enspell
features.description: You can have one Imbue Casting as continual duration on your Weapon, and can skip your Move to change the Spell.

features.name: Spell Parry
features.description: If the result of your Save against a Cast Action exceeds your Difficulty by 10, you can choose a different Target for it, ignoring Immunity. The number needed to exceed is reduced by 1 every 6 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Arcane Surge
features.description: It costs 1 less Mana to Cast your Imbued Spell with other Deliveries. Further, once per Round when you deliver a Spell with an Imbued Weapon, you can do so against one Target for no Mana.

features.name: Esoteric Eye
features.description: You can spend 1 Mana and use your Action or skip your Move to gain Allsight for 1 Minute.

features.name: Sword & Sorcery
features.description: Once per Round, when you take the Attack Action, you can also take the Cast Action, and vice versa.
